rationale: The stock is sitting exactly at the session low with 19 minutes to close, showing a sharp intraday decline of roughly 6% from the high with price compressing in a tight range just above $125.48. While the momentum is clearly downward, entering short at the absolute low with only 19 minutes remaining and forced market-close liquidation creates asymmetric risk — any bounce into close would be punishing, and the spread/slippage on a forced exit is unpredictable. The 1-minute candles show diminishing volume and no clear directional catalyst, making the risk/reward insufficient to justify a new position this late in the session.
